output.summary: Rhizomatous perennial iris native to western China. Its glossy leaves grow atop bamboo-like stems, and its white to pale blue flowers have orange-yellow crests and purple dots. Most parts, particularly the rhizomes and leaves, are poisonous if swallowed and may cause stomach pain and vomiting.
output.edibilityNote: Most parts are poisonous; ingested rhizomes and leaves may cause stomach pain and vomiting.
